description: This file defines a class MultipleImplicitSubscriptionGrain that subscribes to two streams ('red' and 'blue') using Orleans streaming infrastructure, and maintains counters for received events.

classes.name: MultipleImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: A grain class that subscribes to 'red' and 'blue' streams and counts received events.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Activates the grain, subscribes to streams, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: GetCounters
methods.description: Returns the current counts of red and blue events received.
